support.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Gantt chart
translationResources.description: Tasks as bars on a time axis with their progress, groups, milestones and a today line; zooms and pans along the time.

project.title: Project plan
project.description: Each group gets a color and a legend entry, progress is drawn as a solid bar over the task, milestones are dots and today draws a line at a date. Hover a task: its tooltip shows only that task, with its group, dates, duration, progress and dependencies. Dependencies are drawn as arrows.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Each task lists the tasks it waits for in dependencies: an elbow arrow goes from the end of every predecessor to the start of the task, around between the rows when the task starts before its predecessor ends, and into milestones too. dependencyArrows: false keeps them in the tooltip only; dependencyColor sets their color.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.description: A yearly roadmap by team: yAxis.min and max fix the time range; Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel (or a pinch) zooms along the time and dragging pans.

sprint.title: Sprint
sprint.description: Tasks with hours, one color per developer; onPointClick receives the clicked row to show its details.

locale.title: Locales and UTC dates
locale.description: locale sets the month and weekday names, the progress percentages and the default names (tasks, progress, milestones); yAxis.timeZone: "utc" lays the dates out in UTC so that UTC data stays aligned in every time zone.

crews.title: Shared rows
crews.description: A construction schedule by crew: row puts several tasks in one row, and the dependencies point to task ids, so every arrow connects the exact bars. Arrows cross the rows in a lane clear of the other bars, or jog through the gap between two rows when none is free (the dig to the footings, around the rebar).

release-train.title: Release train
release-train.description: A program increment of three teams: row puts the features of a team in one row, group tells features from enablers, and rect annotations along the time axis shade the iterations and tint the innovation and planning (IP) iteration. The system demos are milestones in their own row.

critical-path.title: Critical path
critical-path.description: Earliest and latest starts are computed from the durations and the dependencies (critical path method). With the switch on, group splits the tasks into critical and with slack, and colors paints them red and gray; onPointClick reports the slack of the clicked task.

resources.title: Resource plan
resources.description: One row per person (row), one color per project (group; colors keeps the color of each project when the Select filters them) and yAxis.min / max fix six weeks. onHover reads the hovered row (event.xLabel) to show the load of that person, overbooking included.

live-deploy.title: Live pipeline run
live-deploy.description: A deployment pipeline replayed with setInterval (cleared on pause and unmount): today follows the simulated clock, every progress is recomputed from it, and interaction={false} keeps the time range still while the chart updates.

onboarding.title: Onboarding plan
onboarding.description: renderTooltip replaces the tooltip with React content: the hovered bar is found from its seriesId (one series per group, plus the milestones) and its index, then shown with its owner, its dates formatted with formatRange of Intl.DateTimeFormat and its status relative to today.

daily.title: Swimlanes: a daily schedule
daily.description: A one-day schedule in priority lanes: tasks with the same row share a lane, the domain snaps to whole hours (08:00–22:00) with hour:minute ticks, groups color the tasks by kind and today draws the current time. As several tasks share each lane, barLabels ("auto" by default) writes their names inside the bars, cut with an ellipsis and in a color contrasting with the bar. Tasks without a progress are drawn solid; the code review in progress shows its remaining part translucent.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Tasks by phase with their progress and the launch milestone; pinch to zoom along the time and drag to pan.

daily.title: Daily schedule
daily.description: Priority lanes with several tasks each (row) and their names inside the bars (barLabels), hour ticks for an intra-day range and a line at the current time; tasks without a progress are solid.

GanttChartProps.tasks: Tasks and milestones, from top to bottom
GanttChartProps.today: Draws a line at this date (true: now)

GanttTask.name: Name of the task: the tooltip title, and the row name when there is no row
GanttTask.id: Identifier referenced by the dependencies of other tasks; the name by default (give ids when several tasks have the same name)
GanttTask.row: Row of the task: several tasks can share one (a resource, a lane); the name by default, one row per task
GanttTask.progress: Share done, 0-1: drawn as a solid bar over the task
GanttTask.group: Group (phase, team): a color and a legend entry per group
GanttTask.color: Color of the task (any CSS color); the color of its group by default
GanttTask.milestone: Draws a dot at start instead of a bar
GanttTask.dependencies: Tasks this one waits for, by id (or name): listed in its tooltip and drawn as arrows from their ends, routed around the bars in between

GanttOptions.colors: Colors of the groups in order of appearance (any CSS colors); the chart palette by default
GanttOptions.taskName: Name of the tasks without a group
GanttOptions.progressName: Name of the progress bars (legend, tooltip)
GanttOptions.locale: Locale of the default names and of the progress percentages; the page language by default
GanttOptions.dependenciesName: Name of the dependencies row of the tooltip ("Depends on" in the locale by default)
GanttOptions.dependencyArrows: Draws the dependencies as elbow arrows from the end of every predecessor to the start of the task
GanttOptions.dependencyColor: Color of the dependency arrows (any CSS color); the secondary text color by default
GanttOptions.barLabels: Writes the name of every task inside its bar (cut with an ellipsis, in a color contrasting with the bar, skipped when the bar is too small): "auto" when several tasks share a row, true / "inside" always, false never

project.title: Project plan by phase
project.description: Tasks grouped by phase (one color each) with their progress and a release milestone; zoom along the time.

sprint.title: Sprint with a today line
sprint.description: A two-week sprint: tasks without a group share one color, a dashed line marks today.

daily.title: Swimlanes: a daily schedule
daily.description: Priority lanes with several tasks each (row) and their names inside the bars (bar-labels), hour:minute ticks for an intra-day range and today at the current time; tasks without a progress are solid.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.hideDependencyArrows: Hides the elbow arrows drawn from the end of every predecessor to the start of the task (the dependencies of the tasks)
props.dependencyColor: Color of the dependency arrows (any CSS color); the secondary text color by default
props.barLabels: Writes the task names inside the bars: auto when several tasks share a row (default), true / inside always, false never
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
